tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: Every AI receptionist, virtual receptionist and build-your-own voice AI platform ReceptionistPrices.com prices, with its entry plan, whether it publishes prices, and the date its pricing page was read. Use it to find a vendor's id. Source: ReceptionistPrices.com, prices checked November 8, 2026, htt

tools.name: get_vendor_pricing
tools.description: One vendor's published plans, overage, cost at 3, 5 and 13 three-minute calls a day, billing terms (rounding, time billed beyond the call, spam, setup fee, contract, trial) and which business tools it writes to, each with the URL and the date it was read. Accepts an id or a name, e.g. "Ruby", "Smith

tools.name: compare_at_volume
tools.description: Monthly cost of every AI or virtual receptionist at a call volume and call length, lowest first, from each vendor's cheapest published plan plus overage. Quote-only vendors are listed separately. Defaults: AI receptionists, 3-minute calls. Source: ReceptionistPrices.com, prices checked November 8, 2

tools.name: hire_vs_ai
tools.description: Monthly cost of an in-house receptionist from BLS data (OEWS median wage for SOC 43-4171, national or by state; ECEC employer benefits other than paid leave, which is already paid inside 2,080 paid hours; NCS paid leave days; JOLTS quits times a published replacement-cost share), for one full-time h

tools.name: integrations
tools.description: For Clio, MyCase, Lawmatics, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Google Calendar, Calendly, Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro or Towbook: which AI and virtual receptionists document a built-in integration, which connect through Zapier, and the page that shows it. "Not documented" means neither the vendor's page

tools.name: category_range
tools.description: The range and median monthly cost of AI receptionists or live virtual receptionists at a call volume (3-minute calls), the all-in rate per minute and the range of entry plans. Source: ReceptionistPrices.com, prices checked November 8, 2026, https://www.receptionistprices.com/ai-receptionist-cost/

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_vendor_pricing · Private data: integrations · Public sink: hire_vs_ai.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_vendor_pricing · Private data: integrations · Public sink: hire_vs_ai

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_vendors" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
